status: Document registry records and retired-observer buffers included in retained CPU accounting

behavior: Use one owned registry record allocation per document, including measured Datum allocator header, and prune empty records iteratively. Scene observer storage remains charged to its document. Retired-observer buffers receive allocation lifetime charges including actual capacity/header; growth transfers the charge to its allocating document, compaction updates its size, and empty or dropped owners release it. Weak observations retain no scene payload.
